explore.title: Explore
explore.text: Find the newest and most popular articles from the community here.

write.title: Write an Article
write.text: Share what you know — AI suggests academic sources for you as you write.

profile.title: Your Profile
profile.text: Edit your bio, update your interests, and see your posts from here.

tags.title: Tags
tags.text: Mark your article with relevant tags so it reaches the right readers.

editor.title: Command palette
editor.text: Press '/' while writing: headings, lists, quotes, source suggestions and more, one keystroke away.

sources.title: Suggest sources
sources.text: AI suggests academic sources based on your draft — add a citation with one click.

notes.title: Add from My Notes
notes.text: Move one of the PDF summaries you uploaded on the Notes page into your draft with one click.

cover.title: Cover image
cover.text: Add a cover image if you'd like — optional, you can also publish without one.

publish.title: Publish
publish.text: Publish your article from here when you're ready.
